messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — noticed a weird flow in the model catalog when pinning versions + using the performance badges. Screenshot in thread. The filter chips wrap oddly and the pin affordance disappears at narrow widths.
Maya P: can you drop a quick gif? I'm not seeing it locally.
Alex K: https://figma.com/file/xyz demo gif pasted. Narrow viewport ~980px. The compare table's header compresses so the yellow perf badge gets truncated to `perf:9` which looks like a tag not a metric. Also pin icon moves into overflow menu.
Jordan S: hmm, mental model issue: people expect pin to stick to the row, not to the toolbar. If we move pin to row start it could be more discoverable.
Samir: Agree. Also aria: the pin control needs `aria-pressed` and a visible focus ring. Right now keyboard users can't tell pin state.
Ilana: Copy nit — current tooltip "Pin version" vs "Pin this model version for compare" — longer but clearer in context where pin shows in the toolbar.
Maya P: What about consolidating badges? Perf badge + cost badge -> stacked micro badges to avoid truncation. Or show full label on hover.
Alex K: stacked micro badges is promising. Another idea: collapse to a single summarizing badge like "Perf: 98%ile · $0.02/token" and expand on hover.
DesignBot: Automated accessibility check: color contrast failure on yellow perf badge against white at 12px text (WCAG AA). Recommend darker border or bolder text.
Jordan S: Let's prioritize: 1) Restore pin affordance to row (UX), 2) fix keyboard+a11y attrs for pin + badges, 3) badge truncation pattern (stack vs summarize).
Samir: I'll mock two variants: A) row-start pin + stacked badges, B) toolbar pin + summarizing badge. Will have hi-fi comps by EOD tomorrow.
Ilana: Also include copy alt states in the mock: pinned/unpinned, pinned-other-version message (when multiple pins), and a tooltip copy for summarizing badge.
Maya P: Small perf note — the compare table reflow is expensive with too many badges. If we go stacked badges, try to keep them as pure CSS inline elements (no heavy SVGs) to avoid render jank.
Alex K: Thanks all. Action items: Samir mock two variants, Jordan check keyboard interactions, DesignBot run contrast checks on comps, Ilana provide copy. @Maya P can you do perf smoke test after comps?
Maya P: Yup, will run quick render test on staging once mocks are in.
Jordan S: I'll add a small A/B test plan for discoverability metrics (clicks on pin, time-to-pin) in #product-analytics.
Alex K: Great. Marking this resolved for design sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
